netlist_audit.method: w.audit() re-reads the GENERATED netlist for VGH, every CT_k, every L_k, RS, switch/park widths, the head word and its level, the tank pre-charge, the wire-segment count and values, every cell's effective TG form, and bank-to-bank + rotate connectivity, and REFUSES to invoke Xyce on a mismatch.  237 decks written, zero AUDIT FAIL.
netlist_audit.negative_controls: the audit was proven to CATCH tampering: a VGH edited 2.4->1.5 is caught ('VGH: netlist 1.5 != spec 2.4') and a CT5 node edited is caught.
netlist_audit.a_bug_in_the_guard_itself: audit()'s patterns are ^-anchored and re.findall was called WITHOUT re.MULTILINE, so the guard matched nothing and fail-CLOSED on every deck.  Found by a smoke test BEFORE any chain deck ran; fixed; no result was affected.
